verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair capability to ask of a team collaboration and work-management tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no whiteboard feature in Jira. 'Boards' here are work-tracking views (boards, lists, timeline, calendars), and the Figma and Confluence integrations are third-party or adjacent tools, not a whiteboard Jira itself provides.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
